title: Precalculus
audience: a high-school student (grades 9–12) or an adult reviewing high-school work
purpose: Choose and combine algebraic, graphical and trigonometric representations before starting calculus.

blocks.deliverable: Make a comparison sheet and solve unfamiliar composition problems.
Analyze zeros, multiplicities and asymptotes without a graphing tool first.
Estimate model parameters and check units and plausible ranges.
Week 7 midterm; work conics and coordinate geometry problems.
Derive arithmetic and geometric sum formulas and test simple cases.
Compute secant slopes and explain what a limiting process means.
Complete the portfolio and a 90 minute comprehensive test.

project: Analyze one rational and one trigonometric function with domain, intercepts, asymptotes and transformations.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
